summary.text: Eilish Collins Main is a Democratic member of the Connecticut House of Representatives and a longtime resident of Stamford.

paragraphs.text: According to her House biography, she has 30 years of experience in EdTech management, marketing and business development.
She is the second woman to hold a seat once held for 24 years by Moira Lyons, and has volunteered with Building One Community, the Police Activities League and St. Francis Church outreach programs.
She serves on the Higher Education & Employment Advancement, Commerce and Transportation committees.
